metadata.description: Working discipline and memory for AI coding agents. Pair it with your own private overlay for rules that are yours alone.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Safety hooks and working-discipline skills for AI coding agents, with a local search of your past sessions and lessons from them.

plugins.name: interjector
plugins.description: Opt-in: step into a running session (comment, block, hold), a watcher that does it for you, predict-then-confirm before questions, and session names plus a status board.

plugins.name: supply-chain
plugins.description: Review what a dependency update actually ships: the registry artifacts diffed old vs new, deterministic rules, and a new-committer check.

plugins.name: portal
plugins.description: Optional: a read-only web dashboard over core's effectiveness collector (effectiveness, readiness, usage, open work items, memory search), on your desktop or a server, with an install script, or as one static HTML snapshot.
